# 5 bedroom detached house for sale

> 2 River Meadows This architect-designed five-bedroom riverside retreat combines the tranquillity of the countryside with the convenience of city living. Set across three storeys, the eco-conscious home - complete with solar panels - offers approximately 2,500 sq ft of beautifully crafted contemporary space.
